# Terms & Concepts

A comprehensive glossary of terms, acronyms, and concepts used throughout the Whole Life Journey system.

---

## Intelligence Engines

| Term | Full Name | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| **SUE** | Semantic Understanding Engine | Phase 1 engine that interprets human meaning, extracts entities, and detects ambiguity from user input. Located in `apps/core/ai_semantics/`. |
| **SLCME** | Self-Learning Context Memory Engine | Phase 1 engine that learns from user clarifications and auto-reuses context with confidence scoring. Located in `apps/core/ai_memory/`. |
| **HTIE** | Human Temporal Intelligence Engine | Phase 1 engine that parses natural language time expressions (e.g., "last Tuesday") into precise timestamps. Located in `apps/core/time/`. |
| **UAIO** | Unified AI Orchestrator | Phase 2 engine and central brain that connects all engines to the AI pipeline. The sole execution authority for domain actions. Located in `apps/core/ai_orchestrator/`. |
| **SAE** | State Awareness Engine | Phase 3 engine that maintains a persistent snapshot of each user's current condition across all life domains. Located in `apps/core/ai_state/`. |
| **PIE** | Proactive Insight Engine | Phase 3 engine that generates event-driven and scheduled factual insights from user data. Located in `apps/core/ai_insights/`. |
| **PRIE** | Predictive Intelligence Engine | Phase 3 engine that projects trajectories using linear regression on user data trends. Located in `apps/core/ai_predictions/`. |
| **PGE** | Proactive Guidance Engine | Phase 3 engine that surfaces evidence-based guidance recommendations from state, insights, and predictions. Located in `apps/core/ai_guidance/`. |
| **GLOE** | Guidance Learning Optimization Engine | Phase 3 engine that learns from user interactions with guidance to improve PGE ranking over time. Located in `apps/core/ai_guidance_learning/`. |
| **DBE** | Daily Briefing Engine | Phase 3 engine that aggregates daily intelligence summaries from all engines. Located in `apps/core/ai_briefing/`. |
| **ISE** | Intelligence Scheduler Engine | Phase 3 engine that centrally manages scheduled execution of all intelligence engines. Located in `apps/core/ai_scheduler/`. |
| **WIRE** | Weekly Intelligence Report Engine | Phase 3 engine that generates weekly longitudinal intelligence summaries with trend analysis. Located in `apps/core/ai_weekly_report/`. |
| **E3** | Evidence & Explainability Engine | Phase 3 engine that attaches evidence trails and explanations to PGE, DBE, and WIRE outputs. Located in `apps/core/ai_explain/`. |
| **DNE** | Delivery & Notification Engine | Phase 3 engine that delivers intelligence through in-app, email, SMS, and push with throttling and deduplication. Located in `apps/core/ai_delivery/`. |

---

## Intelligence Pipeline Phases

| Phase | Name | Purpose | Engines |
|-------|------|---------|--------|
| **Phase 1** | Interpretation | Understand user meaning without executing actions | SUE, SLCME, HTIE |
| **Phase 2** | Execution | Execute domain actions (sole execution authority) | UAIO |
| **Phase 3** | Post-Execution | Update state, detect patterns, predict, guide | SAE, PIE, PRIE, PGE, GLOE, DBE, ISE, WIRE, E3, DNE |

---

## Infrastructure & Deployment

| Term | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Railway** | The cloud platform hosting WLJ in production. Provides PostgreSQL database, automatic deployments from GitHub, and runtime logs. |
| **Nixpacks** | The build system used by Railway. Automatically detects the Django/Python stack and creates a container image. Known to aggressively cache start commands. |
| **Gunicorn** | The WSGI HTTP server running Django in production. Uses `--preload` for shared memory and `--timeout 300` for long requests. |
| **Procfile** | Defines the startup command chain for Railway. Runs migrations, loads data, collects static files, then starts Gunicorn. |
| **DataLoadConfig** | Database model tracking which fixture/command loaders have run. Ensures data is loaded only once per deploy cycle. |
| **load_initial_data** | Management command that runs on every deploy. Loads fixtures, runs population commands, applies schema fixes, and executes one-time operations. |

---

## Application Concepts

| Term | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Soft Delete** | Records are never physically removed from the database. Instead, their `status` field is set to `'deleted'`. The default manager (`objects`) automatically excludes deleted records. Use `all_objects` to include them. |
| **UserOwnedModel** | Base model class for all user data. Inherits from `SoftDeleteModel` and adds a `user` foreign key. Provides automatic user-scoped queries. |
| **Module** | A major functional area of the app (Journal, Health, Faith, Life, Purpose, etc.). Each module can be enabled or disabled per user via `UserPreferences`. |
| **Sub-Feature** | A specific capability within a module (e.g., Weight Tracking within Health). Stored as JSON fields on `UserPreferences` for fine-grained control. |
| **Teaching Tool** | The in-app navigation helper ("Where do I...") that matches user queries to `TeachingDestination` records. |
| **Onboarding** | The setup wizard new users complete after signup. Sets module preferences, AI settings, and marks `has_completed_onboarding = True`. Users are redirected to onboarding until complete. |

---

## Security Concepts

| Term | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **CVSS** | Common Vulnerability Scoring System (v3.1). A standard for rating security vulnerabilities on a 0.0-10.0 scale. Used by the security scanner to score findings. |
| **Fernet / AES-256** | The encryption algorithm used for data at rest. Security assessment data and AI personal context are encrypted using Fernet (symmetric AES-256-CBC). |
| **MFA** | Multi-Factor Authentication. WLJ uses email-based 6-digit codes as the second factor. Codes expire after 10 minutes. |
| **WebAuthn / FIDO2** | The standard for passwordless biometric authentication (Face ID, Touch ID). WLJ stores `WebAuthnCredential` records for registered devices. |
| **COPPA** | Children's Online Privacy Protection Act. WLJ requires `date_of_birth` to verify users are 13 or older. |
| **Geo-Blocking** | Signup restriction to USA-only IP addresses by default. International emails can be whitelisted via `AllowedInternationalEmail`. |
| **Disposable Email Detection** | The `DisposableEmailDomain` model maintains a blocklist of throwaway email services to prevent spam signups. |
| **IP Blocklist** | The `IPBlocklist` model blocks specific IP addresses or CIDR ranges. Supports manual, automated, and temporary blocks with expiry dates. |
| **Risk Scoring** | The `SignupAttempt` model computes a composite risk score from reCAPTCHA, IP reputation, email analysis, behavioral patterns, and device fingerprinting. |

---

## Data Models

| Term | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **User** | Custom Django user model using email as the unique identifier. No username field. Extends `AbstractBaseUser` + `PermissionsMixin`. |
| **UserPreferences** | One-to-one with User. Stores all personalization settings: theme, modules, AI config, notifications, timezone, health goals. Auto-created via signal. |
| **TermsAcceptance** | Tracks when users accept terms of service. Each version acceptance creates a new record (audit trail). |
| **ScheduledIntelligenceTask** | Tracks a scheduled intelligence engine task. The ISE checks `next_run_at` to decide whether to execute. |
| **SchedulerLock** | Database-backed singleton lock preventing duplicate APScheduler instances across Gunicorn workers. |
| **SecurityRun** | Master record for a security assessment run. Links to SecurityScore, SecurityTest, and SecurityFinding records. |
| **AcknowledgedFinding** | Documents accepted security risks with justification, mitigating controls, and expiry dates. |
| **AccountDeletionAudit** | Permanent record of account deletions. Stores hashed PII and data counts for compliance and fraud detection. |

---

## Acronyms Quick Reference

| Acronym | Meaning |
|---------|--------|
| WLJ | Whole Life Journey |
| ISE | Intelligence Scheduler Engine |
| ICC | Intelligence Command Center |
| ICQG | Intelligence Calibration & Quality Gate |
| IOCD | Intelligence Observability Dashboard |
| MFA | Multi-Factor Authentication |
| CVSS | Common Vulnerability Scoring System |
| WSGI | Web Server Gateway Interface |
| APNs | Apple Push Notification service |
| FIDO2 | Fast Identity Online (version 2) |
| COPPA | Children's Online Privacy Protection Act |
| GDPR | General Data Protection Regulation |
| PII | Personally Identifiable Information |
| CIDR | Classless Inter-Domain Routing |
